description: 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN fails, and this is the case that pins CBTRN01C's OPEN ORDERING. MAIN-PARA performs six opens in a fixed order at :157-162 - DALYTRAN, CUSTFILE, XREFFILE, CARDFILE, ACCTFILE, TRANFILE - and a successful OPEN displays nothing at all. The ACCTFILE open is the fifth. Its failure therefore asserts three things at once, and the silence is half of the assertion: the four opens before it succeeded, because 'ERROR OPENING ACCOUNT FILE' is the FIRST line after the opening banner and none of the other five open literals precedes it; the fifth paragraph displays its OWN literal (:336) and not 'ERROR OPENING DAILY TRANSACTION FILE' (:263), 'ERROR OPENING CUSTOMER FILE' (:282), 'ERROR OPENING CROSS REF FILE' (:300), 'ERROR OPENING CARD FILE' (:318) or 'ERROR OPENING TRANSACTION FILE' (:354); and the abend stops everything after it, so the sixth open never happens, the PERFORM UNTIL loop at :164-186 never runs, no record is read, no lookup line is emitted, none of the six CLOSE paragraphs at :188-193 is reached and the closing banner at :195 is never displayed. Four lines in total. 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN (:325-341) takes the ELSE arm of both of its ladders in source order (gate G30): the status is not '00' so :331 moves 12, and APPL-AOK is therefore false so :336-339 displays the literal, moves ACCTFILE-STATUS into IO-STATUS, renders it and abends. expectedReturnCode is 12, NOT the 8 that :326 moves in first: every abend site in this program overwrites that assumed-failure value with 0 or 12 before reaching Z-ABEND-PROGRAM, so 8 is never the value at an abend. Z-ABEND-PROGRAM (:469-473) displays 'ABENDING PROGRAM', sets TIMING 0 and ABCODE 999 and issues CALL 'CEE3ABD', which the translation raises as an AbendException carrying RETURN-CODE 12, ABCODE 999 and TIMING 0 (gate G35). THE RENDERER BRANCH. Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS (:476-489) has two arms and this case takes the FIRST one - the extended-status IF at :477-478 - which is what makes it the complement of its sibling case18, whose 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0004' takes the numeric ELSE arm at :484-487. The status value is not invented here: a dataset that cannot be reached at all is reported by the data-access layer as AccountRepository.PERMANENT_ERROR_STATUS, which is the character '9' followed by a zero feedback byte, byte-identical to TransactionPostingJob.PERMANENT_ERROR_STATUS. AccountRepository.open translates the backend failure into exactly that status rather than throwing. It reaches the IF arm for two independent reasons - the group is NOT NUMERIC because the second byte is not a digit, and IO-STAT1 is '9' - and the arm renders IO-STAT1 verbatim plus the second byte's numeric value in three digits, through the TWO-BYTES-BINARY / TWO-BYTES-RIGHT REDEFINES pair at :133-136 and IO-STATUS-0403 PIC 999. A zero feedback byte therefore renders '9000', so the line is 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN9000' - not 'NNNN0090', not 'NNNN9   ' and not 'NNNN0035'. HOW THE FAILURE IS EXPRESSED. ParityCase carries no member that marks a dataset unavailable or forces an open status for a batch case, and that is deliberate: forcedOutcomes lives on screenRequest, which a BATCH_JOB case is refused for declaring. So the failure is expressed the only way the frozen schema allows - by OMITTING the ACCTFILE binding from inputs altogether. An absent binding is a dataset with no resource behind it, which is the open-failure condition; an explicitly declared 'empty' binding is the opposite assertion, a dataset that opens successfully with '00' and reaches end-of-file on its first read, which is the shape CUSTFILE, CARDFILE and TRANFILE carry here and the shape case04 uses for DALYTRAN. That distinction is the mechanism of this case: adding an empty ACCTFILE binding would make the fifth open succeed and would silently turn this into a different case, so it must not be 'fixed' that way. The complementary half is test-side and already exists: because the schema cannot carry a fault, CBTRN01CParityTest induces it deterministically through its own Injection.openFailure, whose openStatusOf defaults every unnamed DD to '00'. Both halves are stated so neither is mistaken for the other. DATASET-LEVEL ORDERING. expectedDatasets names exactly the FOUR datasets whose opens succeeded, on both the WRITES and the FINAL_STATE channel, and names ACCTFILE and TRANFILE on NEITHER. That is the point rather than an omission: a WRITES row count of zero asserts that a dataset was reached and produced nothing, which is true of the four and false of the other two - ACCTFILE could not be opened and TRANFILE was never opened at all, because the abend precedes :162. expectedWrites is empty, which asserts positively that nothing was written anywhere: CBTRN01C contains no WRITE and no REWRITE, so it posts nothing despite the mandated class name TransactionPostingJob - the name comes from the plan, the behaviour from the source. jobParameters is empty because the program is an orphan with no EXEC PGM= anywhere in app/jcl, so it has no PARM to parse. expectedFinalState pins the two seeded datasets unchanged - the daily row by its complete 350-byte image and the cross-reference row by its CVACT03Y fields including the padded FILLER - which is what proves the pre-state survived a run that read nothing. The cross-reference row is seeded at its true fixture width of 36 bytes and padded to the copybook's 50 once at seed time by the declared normalisation, because cardxref.txt omits the trailing FILLER PIC X(14) (gate G16). PRESERVED QUIRKS, none of them tidied: the display literal keeps its unsubstituted 'NNNN' placeholder, which the source never replaces, with the four-character image appended after it; the abend leaves the four opened files unclosed, with no closing banner; and TRANFILE is opened INPUT at :345 and closed at :453 but never read or written in the source at all, and here is never even opened. PROVENANCE. Statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/CBTRN01C.cbl at :155-162, :325-341, :469-473 and :476-489, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy (350), app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy (50) and app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy (300), and seeded from the real fixtures app/data/ASCII/dailytran.txt row 1 and app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt row 21. It is NOT captured from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment (risk R-A, eight verified blockers); only the provenance of the expected values is substituted, and the diff-count-equals-zero gate is unchanged. Gates carried: G13, G15, G16, G18, G19, G21, G30, G35, G47 (the 'other' outcome at an OPEN call site) and G51. G32 does not apply - CBTRN01C contains no GO TO.
